# BTicino C300X Integration v2.7.0

## Unreleased

## Favourites bar

The display can change pages with a bar along the bottom edge instead of the
previous and next arrows. Choose **Favourites bar** under **Page navigation**
in the display settings. Each page has one button and the current page is
marked in yellow. With up to four pages every page has its button; with more
pages the first three have one and the fourth is **More**, which opens the list
of the other pages. The order follows the page positions and the tiles keep
their height. The arrows remain the default.

## Situations

An optional page lists what needs attention among the entities you select:
open doors and windows, open or moving garage doors, lights that are on and
task lists with pending items. Up to 24 entities in total. Unknown and
unavailable entities stay visible. The page is read-only: it runs no action,
does not wake the display and does not change the page by itself. Enable it in
**Display pages**; its default position is 12.

## Picture tiles

Camera and image entities can be placed on the display pages. Each becomes a
picture tile across the page, 200 px high (120 or 290 px with the tile height
setting). Home Assistant scales the picture down before the display loads it.
The tile shows a still, not a stream: an image entity is reloaded when it
changes, a camera about every five minutes. The
display loads the picture directly from Home Assistant at a signed address
that needs no login; see the security notes before placing a camera there.

## Energy page

2.6.0 shipped a display file the device could not read, so the energy page
stayed empty. It loads again after the agent-update Repair of this release.

## Display pages form

The form now reads like the display. The pages that are shown come first, in
display order and numbered from 1. A page the display does not show (switched
off, or without entities) has no number and follows them; its stored position
stays in its section. Free
sections come last and are titled **Page +**; fill one in to add a page. 2.6.0
listed the built-in pages first and gave a switched-off page its stored
position as a number, so the list read Page 1, 2, 10, 11, 3 and so on. Saved
settings and the order on the display do not change.

## Media user setup

Setting up or removing the Home Assistant media user writes a label into the
display files. The agent stopped that script after ten seconds without letting
it clean up, which could leave the device's root filesystem writable after a
slow write. The script now runs to its end.

## Update

This release needs the 2.7.0 agent. After updating the integration, run the
agent-update Repair once: it installs the agent and the three new display
files. The old display stays in place until all of them are installed.
